text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> has made
amazing strides
these past few years,
earning us both a
well-deserved break.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer
<username>?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Next time you have a day off, would
you... like to
spend some time together?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
There's somewhere that I want to take
you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Here we are! It's a hot spring hotel!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
What an amazing building! There are so
many
kinds of baths here. I'm looking
forward to all
their different effects!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I can barely contain myself!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I want to invite Meek here to celebrate
three
years of our working together, but
I figured I
should do some preliminary
research first.
choice_data_list_en: Why a hot spring trip all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I can't look like I have no idea what I'm
doing in
front of her, you know?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: All right, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, the hot water felt great! I'm
starting to
regret only doing a day trip.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Did you try out the flower bath?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The hot water combined with the
jasmine
fragrance was incredibly
relaxing!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah. She definitely would!
choice_data_list: それはミークも喜びそうですね
choice_data_list_en: I'm sure Meek would be happy about that too.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm feeling a bit dizzy after all
those baths.
Could we take a walk
outside?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... I knew the cool air would make
me feel
better.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: You know... Meek and I...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, sorry... Whenever I think of
Umamusume,
there's something that
always comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume and their trainers must
always work
in tandem.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We've struggled so much to get where
we are...
but it wasn't just the two of us
the whole time...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
There were many people who walked by
our side,
providing support and watching
over us...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Delivering their feelings to us with
hopeful eyes.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer's Handbook never
mentioned this,
but... the support of
others really is important to
a racer's
growth...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And that's just one of the lessons I
learned in
these last three years.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Hey... You're right. That's a great idea!
choice_data_list: 書き足さないとですね
choice_data_list_en: Looks like we'll need to add a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I've also learned much from you,
Trainer
<username>.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As a rival and as a friend, you've taught
me so
many things that I didn't know.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And as a trainer, it feels like my
worldview has
been broadened
considerably thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, in that case... we both
helped each
other out, didn't we?
choice_data_list: それはこちらのセリフです

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
With all that I've learned, I want to write
my own
Trainer's Handbook now.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'll include everything from the past
three
years—the successes, the failures,
and so much
more.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Not yet. Hmmm... How about...
choice_data_list_en: What should the opening line be?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Find yourself a lifelong rival—a
supporter you
can cheer on... and a
helper you can be there for."
